estimationPolicy.name: Source-anchored household-equivalent reference classes with conserved cohort allocation

merchant_community.reason: Overseas merchant or maritime resident community

local_branch.reason: Named branch, lineage or local district community

regional_tribal_contingent.reason: Regional contingent of a named tribe; not the worldwide tribe

confederation.reason: Explicit confederation or broad multi-tribal settlement process

estimationPolicy.rangeMeaning: Low/central/high are modelling sensitivity scenarios, not measured confidence intervals.
estimationPolicy.unitScope: Migrating/settling regional cohorts, not total ethnic populations, descendants, or an instantaneous census of all Arabs.
estimationPolicy.fallbackCalibration: Class household counts are declared order-of-magnitude priors, not empirically fitted medieval counts. The source Qays5,000-person stock is a regional-cohort scale check, not a universal tribe size.
estimationPolicy.geographyRule: Never multiply people by a map corridor buffer or destination region area. Those areas are display footprints, not measured occupied settlements.
estimationPolicy.accounting: Duplicate catalogues reference an owner; distinct child movements subtract from their parent; multiple destinations partition the same cohort. Do not sum every estimate row.

methodologySources.title: Frantzman, Levin & Kark (2014), Counting Nomads: British Census Attempts and Tent Counts of the Negev Bedouin 1917 to 1948
methodologySources.application: Household/tent counts multiplied by explicit occupancy, and geographic allocation. This modern case supports the method, not medieval tribal counts or the class household priors.

methodologySources.title: Demography and migration, The New Cambridge History of Islam, chapter10
methodologySources.application: Proxy relationships require explicit justification. No map footprint is treated as a measured occupied area.

methodologySources.title: Population-Area Relationship for Medieval European Cities (2016)
methodologySources.application: Area/density estimation is an alternative when occupied-settlement observations exist. Not applied here because this register supplies no measured occupied areas.
